description: Evaluation-focused proposal for high-value event candidate replay A. Translates the already-completed event/source replay for Finch and Sparrow, The Game Cellar, Next-Gen Games, It's GameTime!, and The Crimson Guild into Places-page assessment fields without adding duplicate event records.
author: Codex Project Steward

fields.assessment_notes: The Game Cellar now reads as a reviewed San Gabriel WPN Premium candidate rather than a generic discovery lead. Existing Commander in the Cellar records already cover recurring Commander opportunities across multiple days, while the official site adds useful qualitative support: weekly events, Commander, draft, prerelease, casual and competitive Magic, newcomer-friendly staff/community positioning, and explicit language around finding a pod. The personal-fit question is not whether Magic happens here; it is whether the best Commander day is socially accessible enough to justify the drive from Los Alamitos. Prior review-derived evidence supports welcoming community and play-space signals, with a small operating-hours reliability caution that should stay visible.

operations.reason: Promote The Game Cellar from placeholder discovery wording to a reviewed candidate with explicit fit, source, and uncertainty framing.

fields.assessment_notes: Next-Gen Games now reads as one of the stronger full-service Magic hubs in the wider field, but not yet a proven casual Commander home-base candidate. The official site confirms WPN Premium status, weekly updated event listings, tournaments every day, Commander/EDH support, and Discord/community routing. Existing Wizards/EventLink data already gives a Wednesday Commander anchor. Prior review-derived evidence supports a large Magic footprint, play space, helpful staff, broad inventory, and inclusive/community signals. The remaining personal-fit uncertainty is practical: distance from Los Alamitos, whether Commander is casual or mixed, whether Discord supports LFG, and whether prerelease/draft may be the better way to try the store.

operations.reason: Promote Next-Gen from placeholder discovery wording to a reviewed Magic-hub candidate while preserving distance and solo-arrival uncertainty.

fields.assessment_notes: It's GameTime is a confirmed Commander option, not just a discovery placeholder. The official site clearly lists EDH / Commander Sundays at 1 PM and Friday Night Magic at 8 PM, and the existing Sunday Commander record should remain the primary Commander anchor. Friday Night Magic should stay as a general Magic signal until its format is confirmed. The venue should be treated cautiously for personal fit because it is farther from Los Alamitos, public evidence does not yet describe pod formation or solo-arrival support, and prior review-derived evidence includes limited play-space concerns plus sharper service/environment/pricing complaints. Keep it visible as a real event option, but below stronger candidates until community fit improves.

operations.reason: Promote It's GameTime from placeholder discovery wording while keeping confirmed schedule support separate from unresolved personal-fit cautions.

fields.assessment_notes: The Crimson Guild now reads as a plausible mid-distance Friday Commander candidate rather than a vague discovery lead. Existing Wizards/EventLink evidence supports Friday Commander Night, while review-derived evidence describes a spacious, clean, modern play area, friendly staff, fair pricing, useful TCG selection, and active weekly events. The official site is active and useful for identity/social routing, but it is still schedule-thin in the replayed text. Confidence should therefore remain tied primarily to Wizards/EventLink for the Commander schedule until a stronger store-controlled event source, social post, or Discord signal is found. Do not over-normalize address or branch details from third-party mirrors in this pass.

operations.reason: Promote Crimson Guild from placeholder discovery wording while preserving schedule-source and solo-arrival uncertainty.
